patch_list: Signs in with an App Check token. Requires a token copied from Yuka installed from Google Play on a rooted phone. Steps are in the Yuka section of PATCHES.md.
Unlocks food preferences, diet alerts and the full history. Search and offline downloads don't work. Signing in needs Sign-in token, except on a root mount install.
